maddeler.e:
امتثلن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَثَلْنَ (imtaṯalna) /im.ta.θal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# اُمْتُثِلْنَ (umtuṯilna) /um.tu.θil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# اِمْتَثِلْنَ (imtaṯilna) /im.ta.θil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
